astronomy_picture_of_the_day.title: Rubin's COSMOS field
astronomy_picture_of_the_day.explanation: There are more than half a million galaxies in the central panel of this image from the NSF-DOE Vera C. Rubin Observatory in Chile.   This is the COSMOS field, a patch of sky several times larger than the full moon, first observed by Hubble.
